articles.title: Trump says 'threat' led US to pull bombers from RAF Fairford
articles.description: The Pentagon confirmed on Sunday it had removed the B1 bombers from the base in England back to their home stations in America.

articles.title: Author and former politician Jeffrey Archer dies aged 86
articles.description: Archer sold more than 300 million books in his five-decade writing career, and his last book, Adam and Eve, was due to be released later this month.

articles.title: Rise in babies in care proceedings raises fears of unnecessary adoptions, experts tell BBC
articles.description: With better support, many babies may not have needed to go into care, File on 4 Investigates is told.

articles.title: MPs call for investigation after Lutnick-Epstein whistleblower dies
articles.description: Simon Andriesz said he felt let down by the UK's Financial Conduct Authority before his death last month.
